summary: Goblin stays in place and slashes the adjacent Acolyte with its scimitar.
Air Elemental shifts south to (6,5), then splits its Multiattack: first Slam at the Bandit, second Slam at the Knight.
The Adult Red Dragon shifts left to (6,4), unleashes its Frightful Presence to rattle all nearby foes, then snaps its jaws at the Acolyte within 10 ft reach.
Aboleth slides south to threaten the Air Elemental and unleashes a full tentacle flurry from 10 ft reach against the lower-AC target.
